define_scope.title: Record the change scope
define_scope.detail: Identify the affected assemblies, documents, hardware revisions and change request. Use your team's change-control process.

update_schematic.title: Update the schematic
update_schematic.detail: Make the required schematic changes, save them to the controlled project location and identify the resulting revision.

schematic_review.title: Review the schematic changes
schematic_review.detail: Check affected nets, component values, symbols, references, power connections and design intent against your team's checklist.

electrical_checks.title: Run applicable schematic checks
electrical_checks.detail: Run the required electrical/design-rule checks, assess warnings and errors, and record or resolve exceptions.

update_pcb.title: Update the PCB layout
update_pcb.detail: Apply required layout changes and confirm the board reflects the intended schematic and design constraints.

pcb_review.title: Review PCB layout changes
pcb_review.detail: Check placement, routing, clearances, constraints, stack-up and other applicable layout rules.

pcb_checks.title: Run applicable PCB design-rule checks
pcb_checks.detail: Run the required DRC and resolve or formally disposition violations in accordance with your team's process.

sync_schematic_pcb.title: Check schematic-to-PCB consistency
sync_schematic_pcb.detail: Confirm the schematic and PCB are synchronised and that component, net and footprint changes are accounted for.

bom_check.title: Review the bill of materials
bom_check.detail: Check affected part numbers, values, lifecycle/availability and approved substitutions where applicable.

manufacturing_outputs.title: Regenerate and verify manufacturing outputs
manufacturing_outputs.detail: Regenerate the required fabrication, assembly, pick-and-place, drill and other outputs from the intended revision; verify the package.

test_plan.title: Review verification and test impact
test_plan.detail: Determine which tests must be repeated, update test records or procedures if needed, and record results.

documentation.title: Update associated engineering documentation
documentation.detail: Update affected drawings, interface documents, release notes, test records and revision history as required.

peer_review.title: Complete the required peer review
peer_review.detail: Obtain review of the exact changed revision and resolve comments according to your team's review process.

approval.title: Obtain required engineering approval
approval.detail: Record approval from the authorised approver against the exact revision intended for release.

release_package.title: Prepare the release package
release_package.detail: Confirm required files, revision identifiers, evidence and release notes are complete and refer to the same intended version.

release_record.title: Complete the controlled release record
release_record.detail: Follow the organisation's release procedure and record the released revision, destination and release reference.

recommended_change_note.title: Add a concise change summary
recommended_change_note.detail: Summarise what changed, why it changed, affected items and any known limitations.

change_type.question: What does this change affect?
change_type.help: Choose the closest match. This determines which checks are relevant.

schematic_edited.question: Have you edited the schematic?
schematic_edited.help: Answer for the revision covered by this change.

schematic_checks.question: Have the required schematic checks been completed?
schematic_checks.help: Include electrical checks and review of any warnings or exceptions required by your process.

pcb_route.question: Does this change affect the PCB layout?
pcb_route.help: Include changes that require board layout, footprint, routing or constraint updates.

pcb_checks.question: Have the required PCB design checks been completed?
pcb_checks.help: Use your team's required DRC and layout review criteria.

bom_needed.question: Are the BOM or component details affected?

manufacturing_needed.question: Do manufacturing or assembly outputs need to change?
manufacturing_needed.help: For example, Gerbers, drill files, assembly drawings or pick-and-place data.

test_impact.question: Does this change affect verification, testing or associated documentation?

other_docs.question: Have all affected engineering deliverables been updated?
other_docs.help: Consider drawings, BOMs, firmware, test procedures, reports and release notes as applicable.

reviewed.question: Has the changed revision been reviewed by the appropriate person?

approved.question: Has the required approval been recorded for this exact revision?
approved.help: If the revision changed after approval, check whether approval must be repeated.

released.question: Has the release been completed using the controlled release process?

result.title: Your next actions
result.intro: Complete the required actions below and follow the controlled engineering process for your project.
